lines: I’m gathering Berries so I can win a\nPokémon Contest.{be01}\nIf you’d like, I’ll share one with you.

What Berries should I plant today?
What color Pokéblocks should I make?{be01}
Fretting over stuff like that is fun
in its own way.

All my Pokémon does is Roar...
No one dares to come near me...{be01}
Sigh... If you would, please take
this TM away...
招式学习器05的内容是吼叫。\n用吼叫可以吓跑宝可梦。
流星瀑布\n通往卡那兹市
化石迷的家\n“欢迎带化石来！”
